knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Insurance and required registration protect against serious loss from the first job, so they come before convenience items.
The runway is the cash set aside divided by the monthly total, with a slow-month allowance included in that total.
Separate accounts make business records clear and checkable. They do not remove receipts, registration or the need for profit.

practicalCriteria: Learner produces a cost register with one-off and recurring items, each marked checked (with source and date).
Learner calculates the runway in months from a monthly total that includes a slow-month allowance.
Learner sets out a business account and receipt routine, and shows one sample receipt filed with its business purpose.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 1 is not done: List the one-off and recurring costs in the six groups, and mark each as checked (with a source and date) or leave it out until it is checked.
